scripts.build: bun run contracts:build && bun run abi && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/gateway typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/agent-tools typecheck
scripts.test: bun test packages/sdk packages/protocol packages/agent-tools apps/gateway/src apps/web/dev-wallet-server.test.ts apps/web/lib/dev-login.test.ts apps/web/lib/dev-deposit.test.ts apps/web/lib/wallet-connect.test.ts apps/web/lib/owner-challenge.test.ts apps/web/lib/owner-auth.test.ts apps/web/lib/payment-setup.test.ts && bun run test:contracts
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.deploy:local: cd packages/contracts && forge script script/DeployLocal.s.sol --rpc-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast --unlocked --sender 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266
scripts.smoke:gateway: bun run --cwd packages/agent-tools build && bun scripts/gateway-smoke.ts
